assumptions: OpenStreetMap road geometry and one-way direction imported on 2026-10-09; network is a bounded Manhattan extract.
Northbound 1st Avenue through-route; nearby cross streets are retained in the network but receive no synthetic cross traffic.
OSM lane and speed tags are retained where present; netconvert defaults and lane connections fill missing attributes.
Traffic signals are imported/guessed with SUMO static timing, not observed NYC signal plans.
Passenger cars only; bus-priority restrictions, cyclists, pedestrians, turn demand, parking and real signal coordination are not calibrated.
Demand is synthetic and this model has not been validated against observed corridor speeds or flows.
Uniform synthetic vehicle arrivals; no calibration to current traffic sensors.
Severe obstruction caps every lane of the selected link at 0.1 m/s until clearance; no rerouting.
Playback shows only the first seed. Metrics are arithmetic means across paired seeds except completed travel time, which is weighted by completed vehicle count.
This Manhattan scenario is separate from workshop archive footage and cannot establish effects of an archived incident.

verification.validation: Local SUMO only; not observed traffic calibration
verification.aggregation_source: Recomputed completed-duration totals from the original saved SUMO tripinfo; all previously reported metrics and trajectories are unchanged.
